title: Driver Mileage — Last 30 Days
description: Compares total distance driven per driver over the past 30 days using a bar chart and a ranked table.

options.content:
This dashboard was created using an AI agent.
The AI agent is in Alpha stage, so the results may contain inaccuracies. Please verify the data before using it.
Job ID: `738dcdfe-f700-46e4-9802-510f2d7cabf3` · Generated: 2026-07-30 10:54:53 UTC

sql.statement:
SELECT
  COALESCE(e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name, 'Unknown') AS category,
  ROUND(SUM(t.trip_distance_meters) / 1000.0, 1) AS value
FROM processed_common_data.trips t
LEFT JOIN raw_business_data.objects o
  ON o.device_id = t.device_id
  AND o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
LEFT JOIN raw_business_data.employees e
  ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id
WHERE t.trip_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND t.trip_start_time < NOW()
GROUP BY COALESCE(e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name, 'Unknown')
ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT
  COALESCE(e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name, 'Unknown Driver') AS driver_name,
  o.object_label AS object_label,
  ROUND(SUM(t.trip_distance_meters) / 1000.0, 2) AS total_mileage_km,
  COUNT(t.trip_start_time) AS trip_count,
  ROUND(AVG(t.avg_speed), 1) AS avg_speed_kmh,
  ROUND(MAX(t.max_speed), 1) AS max_speed_kmh
FROM processed_common_data.trips t
JOIN raw_business_data.objects o ON o.device_id = t.device_id AND o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
LEFT JOIN raw_business_data.employees e ON e.employee_id = t.driver_id
WHERE t.trip_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND t.trip_start_time < NOW()
GROUP BY e.first_name, e.last_name, o.object_label
ORDER BY total_mileage_km DESC
